verses.zh: 上帝的兒子，耶穌基督福音的起頭。
verses.en: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;

verses.zh: 正如先知以賽亞書上記着說： 看哪，我要差遣我的使者在你前面， 預備道路。
verses.en: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

verses.zh: 在曠野有人聲喊着說： 預備主的道， 修直他的路。
verses.en: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.

verses.zh: [照這話]，約翰來了，在曠野施洗，傳悔改的洗禮，使罪得赦。
verses.en: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.

verses.zh: 猶太全地和耶路撒冷的人都出去到約翰那裏，承認他們的罪，在約旦河裏受他的洗。
verses.en: And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.

verses.zh: 約翰穿駱駝毛[的衣服]，腰束皮帶，吃的是蝗蟲、野蜜。
verses.en: And John was clothed with camel's hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;

verses.zh: 他傳道說：「有一位在我以後來的，能力比我更大，我就是彎腰給他解鞋帶也是不配的。
verses.en: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.

verses.zh: 我是用水給你們施洗，他卻要用聖靈給你們施洗。」
verses.en: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.

verses.zh: 那時，耶穌從加利利的拿撒勒來，在約旦河裏受了約翰的洗。
verses.en: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.

verses.zh: 他從水裏一上來，就看見天裂開了，聖靈彷彿鴿子，降在他身上。
verses.en: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:

verses.zh: 又有聲音從天上來，[說]：「你是我的愛子，我喜悅你。」
verses.en: And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

verses.zh: 聖靈就把耶穌催到曠野裏去。
verses.en: And immediately the spirit driveth him into the wilderness.

verses.zh: 他在曠野四十天，受撒但的試探，並與野獸同在一處，且有天使來伺候他。
verses.en: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.

verses.zh: 約翰下監以後，耶穌來到加利利，宣傳上帝的福音，
verses.en: Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,

verses.zh: 說：「日期滿了，上帝的國近了。你們當悔改，信福音！」
verses.en: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.

verses.zh: 耶穌順着加利利的海邊走，看見西門和西門的兄弟安得烈在海裏撒網；他們本是打魚的。
verses.en: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.

verses.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「來跟從我，我要叫你們得人如得魚一樣。」
verses.en: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.

verses.zh: 他們就立刻捨了網，跟從了他。
verses.en: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.

verses.zh: 耶穌稍往前走，又見西庇太的兒子雅各和雅各的兄弟約翰在船上補網。
verses.en: And when he had gone a little farther thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.

verses.zh: 耶穌隨即招呼他們，他們就把父親西庇太和雇工人留在船上，跟從耶穌去了。
verses.en: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.

verses.zh: 到了迦百農，耶穌就在安息日進了會堂教訓人。
verses.en: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.

verses.zh: 眾人很希奇他的教訓；因為他教訓他們，正像有權柄的人，不像文士。
verses.en: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.

verses.zh: 在會堂裏，有一個人被污鬼附着。他喊叫說：
verses.en: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,

verses.zh: 「拿撒勒人耶穌，我們與你有甚麼相干？你來滅我們嗎？我知道你是誰，乃是上帝的聖者。」
verses.en: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.

verses.zh: 耶穌責備他說：「不要作聲！從這人身上出來吧。」
verses.en: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.

verses.zh: 污鬼叫那人抽了一陣瘋，大聲喊叫，就出來了。
verses.en: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.

verses.zh: 眾人都驚訝，以致彼此對問說：「這是甚麼事？是個新道理啊！他用權柄吩咐污鬼，連污鬼也聽從了他。」
verses.en: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.

verses.zh: 耶穌的名聲就傳遍了加利利的四方。
verses.en: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.

verses.zh: 他們一出會堂，就同着雅各、約翰，進了西門和安得烈的家。
verses.en: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

verses.zh: 西門的岳母正害熱病躺着，就有人告訴耶穌。
verses.en: But Simon's wife's mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.

verses.zh: 耶穌進前拉着她的手，扶她起來，熱就退了，她就服事他們。
verses.en: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.

verses.zh: 天晚日落的時候，有人帶着一切害病的，和被鬼附的，來到耶穌跟前。
verses.en: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.

verses.zh: 合城的人都聚集在門前。
verses.en: And all the city was gathered together at the door.

verses.zh: 耶穌治好了許多害各樣病的人，又趕出許多鬼，不許鬼說話，因為鬼認識他。
verses.en: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.

verses.zh: 次日早晨，天未亮的時候，耶穌起來，到曠野地方去，在那裏禱告。
verses.en: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.

verses.zh: 西門和同伴追了他去，
verses.en: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.

verses.zh: 遇見了就對他說：「眾人都找你。」
verses.en: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.

verses.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「我們可以往別處去，到鄰近的鄉村，我也好在那裏傳道，因為我是為這事出來的。」
verses.en: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.

verses.zh: 於是在加利利全地，進了會堂，傳道，趕鬼。
verses.en: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.

verses.zh: 有一個長大痲瘋的來求耶穌，向他跪下，說：「你若肯，必能叫我潔淨了。」
verses.en: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.

verses.zh: 耶穌動了慈心，就伸手摸他，說：「我肯，你潔淨了吧！」
verses.en: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.

verses.zh: 大痲瘋即時離開他，他就潔淨了。
verses.en: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.

verses.zh: 耶穌嚴嚴地囑咐他，就打發他走，
verses.en: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;

verses.zh: 對他說：「你要謹慎，甚麼話都不可告訴人，只要去把身體給祭司察看，又因為你潔淨了，獻上摩西所吩咐的禮物，對眾人作證據。」
verses.en: And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.

verses.zh: 那人出去，倒說許多的話，把這件事傳揚開了，叫耶穌以後不得再明明地進城，只好在外邊曠野地方。人從各處都就了他來。
verses.en: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.

verses.zh: 過了些日子，耶穌又進了迦百農。人聽見他在房子裏，
verses.en: And again he entered into Capernaum after some days; and it was noised that he was in the house.

verses.zh: 就有許多人聚集，甚至連門前都沒有空地；耶穌就對他們講道。
verses.en: And straightway many were gathered together, insomuch that there was no room to receive them, no, not so much as about the door: and he preached the word unto them.

verses.zh: 有人帶着一個癱子來見耶穌，是用四個人抬來的；
verses.en: And they come unto him, bringing one sick of the palsy, which was borne of four.

verses.zh: 因為人多，不得近前，就把耶穌所在的房子，拆了房頂，既拆通了，就把癱子連所躺臥的褥子都縋下來。
verses.en: And when they could not come nigh unto him for the press, they uncovered the roof where he was: and when they had broken it up, they let down the bed wherein the sick of the palsy lay.

verses.zh: 耶穌見他們的信心，就對癱子說：「小子，你的罪赦了。」
verses.en: When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.

verses.zh: 有幾個文士坐在那裏，心裏議論，說：
verses.en: But there was certain of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,

verses.zh: 「這個人為甚麼這樣說呢？他說僭妄的話了。除了上帝以外，誰能赦罪呢？」
verses.en: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?

verses.zh: 耶穌心中知道他們心裏這樣議論，就說：「你們心裏為甚麼這樣議論呢？
verses.en: And immediately when Jesus perceived in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, he said unto them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?

verses.zh: 或對癱子說『你的罪赦了』，或說『起來！拿你的褥子行走』，哪一樣容易呢？
verses.en: Whether is it easier to say to the sick of the palsy, Thy sins be forgiven thee; or to say, Arise, and take up thy bed, and walk?

verses.zh: 但要叫你們知道，人子在地上有赦罪的權柄。」就對癱子說：
verses.en: But that ye may know that the Son of man hath power on earth to forgive sins, (he saith to the sick of the palsy,)

verses.zh: 「我吩咐你，起來！拿你的褥子回家去吧。」
verses.en: I say unto thee, Arise, and take up thy bed, and go thy way into thine house.

verses.zh: 那人就起來，立刻拿着褥子，當眾人面前出去了，以致眾人都驚奇，歸榮耀與上帝，說：「我們從來沒有見過這樣的事！」
verses.en: And immediately he arose, took up the bed, and went forth before them all; insomuch that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it on this fashion.

verses.zh: 耶穌又出到海邊去，眾人都就了他來，他便教訓他們。
verses.en: And he went forth again by the sea side; and all the multitude resorted unto him, and he taught them.

verses.zh: 耶穌經過的時候，看見亞勒腓的兒子利未坐在稅關上，就對他說：「你跟從我來。」他就起來，跟從了耶穌。
verses.en: And as he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the receipt of custom, and said unto him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.

verses.zh: 耶穌在利未家裏坐席的時候，有好些稅吏和罪人與耶穌並門徒一同坐席；因為這樣的人多，他們也跟隨耶穌。
verses.en: And it came to pass, that, as Jesus sat at meat in his house, many publicans and sinners sat also together with Jesus and his disciples: for there were many, and they followed him.

verses.zh: 法利賽人中的文士看見耶穌和罪人並稅吏一同吃飯，就對他門徒說：「他和稅吏並罪人一同吃喝嗎？」
verses.en: And when the scribes and Pharisees saw him eat with publicans and sinners, they said unto his disciples, How is it that he eateth and drinketh with publicans and sinners?

verses.zh: 耶穌聽見，就對他們說：「康健的人用不着醫生，有病的人才用得着。我來本不是召義人，乃是召罪人。」
verses.en: When Jesus heard it, he saith unto them, They that are whole have no need of the physician, but they that are sick: I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

verses.zh: 當下，約翰的門徒和法利賽人禁食。他們來問耶穌說：「約翰的門徒和法利賽人的門徒禁食，你的門徒倒不禁食，這是為甚麼呢？」
verses.en: And the disciples of John and of the Pharisees used to fast: and they come and say unto him, Why do the disciples of John and of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?

verses.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「新郎和陪伴之人同在的時候，陪伴之人豈能禁食呢？新郎還同在，他們不能禁食。
verses.en: And Jesus said unto them, Can the children of the bridechamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they cannot fast.

verses.zh: 但日子將到，新郎要離開他們，那日他們就要禁食。
verses.en: But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days.

verses.zh: 沒有人把新布縫在舊衣服上，恐怕所補上的新布帶壞了舊衣服，破的就更大了。
verses.en: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.

verses.zh: 也沒有人把新酒裝在舊皮袋裏，恐怕酒把皮袋裂開，酒和皮袋就都壞了；惟把新酒裝在新皮袋裏。」
verses.en: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.

verses.zh: 耶穌當安息日從麥地經過。他門徒行路的時候，掐了麥穗。
verses.en: And it came to pass, that he went through the corn fields on the sabbath day; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of corn.

verses.zh: 法利賽人對耶穌說：「看哪，他們在安息日為甚麼做不可做的事呢？」
verses.en: And the Pharisees said unto him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath day that which is not lawful?

verses.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「[經上記着]大衛和跟從他的人缺乏飢餓之時所做的事，你們沒有念過嗎？
verses.en: And he said unto them, Have ye never read what David did, when he had need, and was an hungred, he, and they that were with him?

verses.zh: 他當亞比亞他作大祭司的時候，怎麼進了上帝的殿，吃了陳設餅，又給跟從他的人吃。這餅除了祭司以外，人都不可吃。」
verses.en: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?

verses.zh: 又對他們說：「安息日是為人設立的，人不是為安息日設立的。
verses.en: And he said unto them, The sabbath was made for man, and not man for the sabbath:

verses.zh: 所以，人子也是安息日的主。」
verses.en: Therefore the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.

verses.zh: 耶穌又進了會堂，在那裏有一個人枯乾了一隻手。
verses.en: And he entered again into the synagogue; and there was a man there which had a withered hand.

verses.zh: 眾人窺探耶穌，在安息日醫治不醫治，意思是要控告耶穌。
verses.en: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.

verses.zh: 耶穌對那枯乾一隻手的人說：「起來，站在當中。」
verses.en: And he saith unto the man which had the withered hand, Stand forth.

verses.zh: 又問眾人說：「在安息日行善行惡，救命害命，哪樣是可以的呢？」他們都不作聲。
verses.en: And he saith unto them, Is it lawful to do good on the sabbath days, or to do evil? to save life, or to kill? But they held their peace.

verses.zh: 耶穌怒目周圍看他們，憂愁他們的心剛硬，就對那人說：「伸出手來！」他把手一伸，手就復了原。
verses.en: And when he had looked round about on them with anger, being grieved for the hardness of their hearts, he saith unto the man, Stretch forth thine hand. And he stretched it out: and his hand was restored whole as the other.

verses.zh: 法利賽人出去，同希律一黨的人商議怎樣可以除滅耶穌。
verses.en: And the Pharisees went forth, and straightway took counsel with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

verses.zh: 耶穌和門徒退到海邊去，有許多人從加利利跟隨他。
verses.en: But Jesus withdrew himself with his disciples to the sea: and a great multitude from Galilee followed him, and from Judaea,

verses.zh: 還有許多人聽見他所做的大事，就從猶太、耶路撒冷、以土買、約旦河外，並泰爾、西頓的四方來到他那裏。
verses.en: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and from beyond Jordan; and they about Tyre and Sidon, a great multitude, when they had heard what great things he did, came unto him.

verses.zh: 他因為人多，就吩咐門徒叫一隻小船伺候着，免得眾人擁擠他。
verses.en: And he spake to his disciples, that a small ship should wait on him because of the multitude, lest they should throng him.

verses.zh: 他治好了許多人，所以凡有災病的，都擠進來要摸他。
verses.en: For he had healed many; insomuch that they pressed upon him for to touch him, as many as had plagues.

verses.zh: 污鬼無論何時看見他，就俯伏在他面前，喊着說：「你是上帝的兒子。」
verses.en: And unclean spirits, when they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, saying, Thou art the Son of God.

verses.zh: 耶穌再三地囑咐他們，不要把他顯露出來。
verses.en: And he straitly charged them that they should not make him known.

verses.zh: 耶穌上了山，隨自己的意思叫人來；他們便來到他那裏。
verses.en: And he goeth up into a mountain, and calleth unto him whom he would: and they came unto him.

verses.zh: 他就設立十二個人，要他們常和自己同在，也要差他們去傳道，
verses.en: And he ordained twelve, that they should be with him, and that he might send them forth to preach,

verses.zh: 並給他們權柄趕鬼。
verses.en: And to have power to heal sicknesses, and to cast out devils:

verses.zh: [這十二個人]有西門（耶穌又給他起名叫彼得），
verses.en: And Simon he surnamed Peter;

verses.zh: 還有西庇太的兒子雅各和雅各的兄弟約翰（又給這兩個人起名叫半尼其，就是雷子的意思），
verses.en: And James the son of Zebedee, and John the brother of James; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder:

verses.zh: 又有安得烈、腓力、巴多羅買、馬太、多馬、亞勒腓的兒子雅各，和達太，並奮銳黨的西門，
verses.en: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Canaanite,

verses.zh: 還有賣耶穌的加略人猶大。
verses.en: And Judas Iscariot, which also betrayed him: and they went into an house.

verses.zh: 耶穌進了一個屋子，眾人又聚集，甚至他連飯也顧不得吃。
verses.en: And the multitude cometh together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

verses.zh: 耶穌的親屬聽見，就出來要拉住他，因為他們說他癲狂了。
verses.en: And when his friends heard of it, they went out to lay hold on him: for they said, He is beside himself.

verses.zh: 從耶路撒冷下來的文士說：「他是被別西卜附着」；又說：「他是靠着鬼王趕鬼。」
verses.en: And the scribes which came down from Jerusalem said, He hath Beelzebub, and by the prince of the devils casteth he out devils.

verses.zh: 耶穌叫他們來，用比喻對他們說：「撒但怎能趕出撒但呢？
verses.en: And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?

verses.zh: 若一國自相紛爭，那國就站立不住；
verses.en: And if a kingdom be divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

verses.zh: 若一家自相紛爭，那家就站立不住。
verses.en: And if a house be divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

verses.zh: 若撒但自相攻打紛爭，他就站立不住，必要滅亡。
verses.en: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.

verses.zh: 沒有人能進壯士家裏，搶奪他的家具；必先捆住那壯士，才可以搶奪他的家。
verses.en: No man can enter into a strong man's house, and spoil his goods, except he will first bind the strong man; and then he will spoil his house.

verses.zh: 我實在告訴你們，世人一切的罪和一切褻瀆的話都可得赦免；
verses.en: Verily I say unto you, All sins shall be forgiven unto the sons of men, and blasphemies wherewith soever they shall blaspheme:

verses.zh: 凡褻瀆聖靈的，卻永不得赦免，乃要擔當永遠的罪。」
verses.en: But he that shall blaspheme against the Holy Ghost hath never forgiveness, but is in danger of eternal damnation.

verses.zh: [這話是]因為他們說：「他是被污鬼附着的。」
verses.en: Because they said, He hath an unclean spirit.

verses.zh: 當下，耶穌的母親和弟兄來，站在外邊，打發人去叫他。
verses.en: There came then his brethren and his mother, and, standing without, sent unto him, calling him.

verses.zh: 有許多人在耶穌周圍坐着，他們就告訴他說：「看哪，你母親和你弟兄在外邊找你。」
verses.en: And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.

verses.zh: 耶穌回答說：「誰是我的母親？誰是我的弟兄？」
verses.en: And he answered them, saying, Who is my mother, or my brethren?

verses.zh: 就四面觀看那周圍坐着的人，說：「看哪，我的母親，我的弟兄。
verses.en: And he looked round about on them which sat about him, and said, Behold my mother and my brethren!

verses.zh: 凡遵行上帝旨意的人就是我的弟兄姊妹和母親了。」
verses.en: For whosoever shall do the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.

verses.zh: 耶穌又在海邊教訓人。有許多人到他那裏聚集，他只得上船坐下。船在海裏，眾人都靠近海，站在岸上。
verses.en: And he began again to teach by the sea side: and there was gathered unto him a great multitude, so that he entered into a ship, and sat in the sea; and the whole multitude was by the sea on the land.

verses.zh: 耶穌就用比喻教訓他們許多道理。在教訓之間，對他們說：
verses.en: And he taught them many things by parables, and said unto them in his doctrine,

verses.zh: 「你們聽啊！有一個撒種的出去撒種。
verses.en: Hearken; Behold, there went out a sower to sow:

verses.zh: 撒的時候，有落在路旁的，飛鳥來吃盡了；
verses.en: And it came to pass, as he sowed, some fell by the way side, and the fowls of the air came and devoured it up.

verses.zh: 有落在土淺石頭地上的，土既不深，發苗最快，
verses.en: And some fell on stony ground, where it had not much earth; and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of earth:

verses.zh: 日頭出來一曬，因為沒有根，就枯乾了；
verses.en: But when the sun was up, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

verses.zh: 有落在荊棘裏的，荊棘長起來，把它 擠住了，就不結實；
verses.en: And some fell among thorns, and the thorns grew up, and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

verses.zh: 又有落在好土裏的，就發生長大，結實有三十倍的，有六十倍的，有一百倍的」；
verses.en: And other fell on good ground, and did yield fruit that sprang up and increased; and brought forth, some thirty, and some sixty, and some an hundred.

verses.zh: 又說：「有耳可聽的，就應當聽！」
verses.en: And he said unto them, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.

verses.zh: 無人的時候，跟隨耶穌的人和十二個門徒問他這比喻的意思。
verses.en: And when he was alone, they that were about him with the twelve asked of him the parable.

verses.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「上帝國的奧祕只叫你們知道，若是對外人講，凡事就用比喻，
verses.en: And he said unto them, Unto you it is given to know the mystery of the kingdom of God: but unto them that are without, all these things are done in parables:

verses.zh: 叫他們 看是看見，卻不曉得； 聽是聽見，卻不明白； 恐怕他們回轉過來，就得赦免。」
verses.en: That seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest at any time they should be converted, and their sins should be forgiven them.

verses.zh: 又對他們說：「你們不明白這比喻嗎？這樣怎能明白一切的比喻呢？
verses.en: And he said unto them, Know ye not this parable? and how then will ye know all parables?

verses.zh: 撒種之人所撒的就是道。
verses.en: The sower soweth the word.

verses.zh: 那撒在路旁的，就是人聽了道，撒但立刻來，把撒在他心裏的道奪了去。
verses.en: And these are they by the way side, where the word is sown; but when they have heard, Satan cometh immediately, and taketh away the word that was sown in their hearts.

verses.zh: 那撒在石頭地上的，就是人聽了道，立刻歡喜領受，
verses.en: And these are they likewise which are sown on stony ground; who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with gladness;

verses.zh: 但他心裏沒有根，不過是暫時的，及至為道遭了患難，或是受了逼迫，立刻就跌倒了。
verses.en: And have no root in themselves, and so endure but for a time: afterward, when affliction or persecution ariseth for the word's sake, immediately they are offended.

verses.zh: 還有那撒在荊棘裏的，就是人聽了道，
verses.en: And these are they which are sown among thorns; such as hear the word,

verses.zh: 後來有世上的思慮、錢財的迷惑，和別樣的私慾進來，把道擠住了，就不能結實。
verses.en: And the cares of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in, choke the word, and it becometh unfruitful.

verses.zh: 那撒在好地上的，就是人聽道，又領受，並且結實，有三十倍的，有六十倍的，有一百倍的。」
verses.en: And these are they which are sown on good ground; such as hear the word, and receive it, and bring forth fruit, some thirtyfold, some sixty, and some an hundred.

verses.zh: 耶穌又對他們說：「人拿燈來，豈是要放在斗底下，床底下，不放在燈臺上嗎？
verses.en: And he said unto them, Is a candle brought to be put under a bushel, or under a bed? and not to be set on a candlestick?

verses.zh: 因為掩藏的事，沒有不顯出來的；隱瞞的事，沒有不露出來的。
verses.en: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.

verses.zh: 有耳可聽的，就應當聽！」
verses.en: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.

verses.zh: 又說：「你們所聽的要留心。你們用甚麼量器量給人，也必用甚麼量器量給你們，並且要多給你們。
verses.en: And he said unto them, Take heed what ye hear: with what measure ye mete, it shall be measured to you: and unto you that hear shall more be given.

verses.zh: 因為有的，還要給他；沒有的，連他所有的也要奪去。」
verses.en: For he that hath, to him shall be given: and he that hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he hath.

verses.zh: 又說：「上帝的國如同人把種撒在地上。
verses.en: And he said, So is the kingdom of God, as if a man should cast seed into the ground;

verses.zh: 黑夜睡覺，白日起來，這種就發芽漸長，那人卻不曉得如何這樣。
verses.en: And should sleep, and rise night and day, and the seed should spring and grow up, he knoweth not how.

verses.zh: 地生五穀是出於自然的：先發苗，後長穗，再後穗上結成飽滿的子粒；
verses.en: For the earth bringeth forth fruit of herself; first the blade, then the ear, after that the full corn in the ear.

verses.zh: 穀既熟了，就用鐮刀去割，因為收成的時候到了。」
verses.en: But when the fruit is brought forth, immediately he putteth in the sickle, because the harvest is come.

verses.zh: 又說：「上帝的國，我們可用甚麼比較呢？可用甚麼比喻表明呢？
verses.en: And he said, Whereunto shall we liken the kingdom of God? or with what comparison shall we compare it?

verses.zh: 好像一粒芥菜種，種在地裏的時候，雖比地上的百種都小，
verses.en: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, is less than all the seeds that be in the earth:

verses.zh: 但種上以後，就長起來，比各樣的菜都大，又長出大枝來，甚至天上的飛鳥可以宿在它 的蔭下。」
verses.en: But when it is sown, it groweth up, and becometh greater than all herbs, and shooteth out great branches; so that the fowls of the air may lodge under the shadow of it.

verses.zh: 耶穌用許多這樣的比喻，照他們所能聽的，對他們講道。
verses.en: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it.

verses.zh: 若不用比喻，就不對他們講；沒有人的時候，就把一切的道講給門徒聽。
verses.en: But without a parable spake he not unto them: and when they were alone, he expounded all things to his disciples.

verses.zh: 當那天晚上，耶穌對門徒說：「我們渡到那邊去吧。」
verses.en: And the same day, when the even was come, he saith unto them, Let us pass over unto the other side.

verses.zh: 門徒離開眾人，耶穌仍在船上，他們就把他一同帶去；也有別的船和他同行。
verses.en: And when they had sent away the multitude, they took him even as he was in the ship. And there were also with him other little ships.

verses.zh: 忽然起了暴風，波浪打入船內，甚至船要滿了水。
verses.en: And there arose a great storm of wind, and the waves beat into the ship, so that it was now full.

verses.zh: 耶穌在船尾上，枕着枕頭睡覺。門徒叫醒了他，說：「夫子！我們喪命，你不顧嗎？」
verses.en: And he was in the hinder part of the ship, asleep on a pillow: and they awake him, and say unto him, Master, carest thou not that we perish?

verses.zh: 耶穌醒了，斥責風，向海說：「住了吧！靜了吧！」風就止住，大大地平靜了。
verses.en: And he arose, and rebuked the wind, and said unto the sea, Peace, be still. And the wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

verses.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「為甚麼膽怯？你們還沒有信心嗎？」
verses.en: And he said unto them, Why are ye so fearful? how is it that ye have no faith?

verses.zh: 他們就大大地懼怕，彼此說：「這到底是誰，連風和海也聽從他了。」
verses.en: And they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?

verses.zh: 他們來到海那邊格拉森人的地方。
verses.en: And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

verses.zh: 耶穌一下船，就有一個被污鬼附着的人從墳塋裏出來迎着他。
verses.en: And when he was come out of the ship, immediately there met him out of the tombs a man with an unclean spirit,

verses.zh: 那人常住在墳塋裏，沒有人能捆住他，就是用鐵鍊也不能；
verses.en: Who had his dwelling among the tombs; and no man could bind him, no, not with chains:

verses.zh: 因為人屢次用腳鐐和鐵鍊捆鎖他，鐵鍊竟被他掙斷了，腳鐐也被他弄碎了；總沒有人能制伏他。
verses.en: Because that he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been plucked asunder by him, and the fetters broken in pieces: neither could any man tame him.

verses.zh: 他晝夜常在墳塋裏和山中喊叫，又用石頭砍自己。
verses.en: And always, night and day, he was in the mountains, and in the tombs, crying, and cutting himself with stones.

verses.zh: 他遠遠地看見耶穌，就跑過去拜他，
verses.en: But when he saw Jesus afar off, he ran and worshipped him,

verses.zh: 大聲呼叫說：「至高上帝的兒子耶穌，我與你有甚麼相干？我指着上帝懇求你，不要叫我受苦！」
verses.en: And cried with a loud voice, and said, What have I to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of the most high God? I adjure thee by God, that thou torment me not.

verses.zh: 是因耶穌曾吩咐他說：「污鬼啊，從這人身上出來吧！」
verses.en: For he said unto him, Come out of the man, thou unclean spirit.

verses.zh: 耶穌問他說：「你名叫甚麼？」回答說：「我名叫『群』，因為我們多的緣故」；
verses.en: And he asked him, What is thy name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.

verses.zh: 就再三地求耶穌，不要叫他們離開那地方。
verses.en: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

verses.zh: 在那裏山坡上，有一大群豬吃食；
verses.en: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.

verses.zh: 鬼就央求耶穌說：「求你打發我們往豬群裏，附着豬去。」
verses.en: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.

verses.zh: 耶穌准了他們，污鬼就出來，進入豬裏去。於是那群豬闖下山崖，投在海裏，淹死了。[豬的數目]約有二千。
verses.en: And forthwith Jesus gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.

verses.zh: 放豬的就逃跑了，去告訴城裏和鄉下的人。眾人就來，要看是甚麼事。
verses.en: And they that fed the swine fled, and told it in the city, and in the country. And they went out to see what it was that was done.

verses.zh: 他們來到耶穌那裏，看見那被鬼附着的人，就是從前被群鬼所附的，坐着，穿上衣服，心裏明白過來，他們就害怕。
verses.en: And they come to Jesus, and see him that was possessed with the devil, and had the legion, sitting, and clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.

verses.zh: 看見這事的，便將鬼附之人所遇見的和那群豬的事都告訴了眾人；
verses.en: And they that saw it told them how it befell to him that was possessed with the devil, and also concerning the swine.

verses.zh: 眾人就央求耶穌離開他們的境界。
verses.en: And they began to pray him to depart out of their coasts.

verses.zh: 耶穌上船的時候，那從前被鬼附着的人懇求和耶穌同在。
verses.en: And when he was come into the ship, he that had been possessed with the devil prayed him that he might be with him.

verses.zh: 耶穌不許，卻對他說：「你回家去，到你的親屬那裏，將主為你所做的是何等大的事，是怎樣憐憫你，都告訴他們。」
verses.en: Howbeit Jesus suffered him not, but saith unto him, Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things the Lord hath done for thee, and hath had compassion on thee.

verses.zh: 那人就走了，在低加坡里傳揚耶穌為他做了何等大的事，眾人就都希奇。
verses.en: And he departed, and began to publish in Decapolis how great things Jesus had done for him: and all men did marvel.

verses.zh: 耶穌坐船又渡到那邊去，就有許多人到他那裏聚集；他正在海邊上。
verses.en: And when Jesus was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.

verses.zh: 有一個管會堂的人，名叫睚魯，來見耶穌，就俯伏在他腳前，
verses.en: And, behold, there cometh one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name; and when he saw him, he fell at his feet,

verses.zh: 再三地求他，說：「我的小女兒快要死了，[求你]去按手在她身上，使她痊癒，得以活了。」
verses.en: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lieth at the point of death: I pray thee, come and lay thy hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.

verses.zh: 耶穌就和他同去。 有許多人跟隨擁擠他。
verses.en: And Jesus went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.

verses.zh: 有一個女人，患了十二年的血漏，
verses.en: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years,

verses.zh: 在好些醫生手裏受了許多的苦，又花盡了她所有的，一點也不見好，病勢反倒更重了。
verses.en: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,

verses.zh: 她聽見耶穌的事，就從後頭來，雜在眾人中間，摸耶穌的衣裳，
verses.en: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.

verses.zh: 意思說：「我只摸他的衣裳，就必痊癒。」
verses.en: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.

verses.zh: 於是她血漏的源頭立刻乾了；她便覺得身上的災病好了。
verses.en: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.

verses.zh: 耶穌頓時心裏覺得有能力從自己身上出去，就在眾人中間轉過來，說：「誰摸我的衣裳？」
verses.en: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, Who touched my clothes?

verses.zh: 門徒對他說：「你看眾人擁擠你，還說『誰摸我』嗎？」
verses.en: And his disciples said unto him, Thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?

verses.zh: 耶穌周圍觀看，要見做這事的女人。
verses.en: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.

verses.zh: 那女人知道在自己身上所成的事，就恐懼戰兢，來俯伏在耶穌跟前，將實情全告訴他。
verses.en: But the woman fearing and trembling, knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

verses.zh: 耶穌對她說：「女兒，你的信救了你，平平安安地回去吧！你的災病痊癒了。」
verses.en: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.

verses.zh: 還說話的時候，有人從管會堂的家裏來，說：「你的女兒死了，何必還勞動先生呢？」
verses.en: While he yet spake, there came from the ruler of the synagogue's house certain which said, Thy daughter is dead: why troublest thou the Master any further?

verses.zh: 耶穌聽見所說的話，就對管會堂的說：「不要怕，只要信！」
verses.en: As soon as Jesus heard the word that was spoken, he saith unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.

verses.zh: 於是帶着彼得、雅各，和雅各的兄弟約翰同去，不許別人跟隨他。
verses.en: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.

verses.zh: 他們來到管會堂的家裏；耶穌看見那裏亂嚷，並有人大大地哭泣哀號，
verses.en: And he cometh to the house of the ruler of the synagogue, and seeth the tumult, and them that wept and wailed greatly.

verses.zh: 進到裏面，就對他們說：「為甚麼亂嚷哭泣呢？孩子不是死了，是睡着了。」
verses.en: And when he was come in, he saith unto them, Why make ye this ado, and weep? the damsel is not dead, but sleepeth.

verses.zh: 他們就嗤笑耶穌。耶穌把他們都攆出去，就帶着孩子的父母和跟隨的人進了孩子所在的地方，
verses.en: And they laughed him to scorn. But when he had put them all out, he taketh the father and the mother of the damsel, and them that were with him, and entereth in where the damsel was lying.

verses.zh: 就拉着孩子的手，對她說：「大利大，古米！」（翻出來就是說：「閨女，我吩咐你起來！」）
verses.en: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise.

verses.zh: 那閨女立時起來走。他們就大大地驚奇；閨女已經十二歲了。
verses.en: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.

verses.zh: 耶穌切切地囑咐他們，不要叫人知道這事，又吩咐給她東西吃。
verses.en: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.

verses.zh: 耶穌離開那裏，來到自己的家鄉；門徒也跟從他。
verses.en: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.

verses.zh: 到了安息日，他在會堂裏教訓人。眾人聽見，就甚希奇，說：「這人從哪裏有這些事呢？所賜給他的是甚麼智慧？他手所做的是何等的異能呢？
verses.en: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence hath this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?

verses.zh: 這不是那木匠嗎？不是馬利亞的兒子雅各、約西、猶大、西門的長兄嗎？他妹妹們不也是在我們這裏嗎？」他們就厭棄他。
verses.en: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.

verses.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「大凡先知，除了本地、親屬、本家之外，沒有不被人尊敬的。」
verses.en: But Jesus, said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.

verses.zh: 耶穌就在那裏不得行甚麼異能，不過按手在幾個病人身上，治好他們。
verses.en: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.

verses.zh: 他也詫異他們不信，就往周圍鄉村教訓人去了。
verses.en: And he marvelled because of their unbelief. And he went round about the villages, teaching.

verses.zh: 耶穌叫了十二個門徒來，差遣他們兩個兩個地出去，也賜給他們權柄，制伏污鬼；
verses.en: And he called unto him the twelve, and began to send them forth by two and two; and gave them power over unclean spirits;

verses.zh: 並且囑咐他們：「行路的時候不要帶食物和口袋，腰袋裏也不要帶錢，除了柺杖以外，甚麼都不要帶；
verses.en: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:

verses.zh: 只要穿鞋，也不要穿兩件褂子」；
verses.en: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.

verses.zh: 又對他們說：「你們無論到何處，進了人的家，就住在那裏，直到離開那地方。
verses.en: And he said unto them, In what place soever ye enter into an house, there abide till ye depart from that place.

verses.zh: 何處的人不接待你們，不聽你們，你們離開那裏的時候，就把腳上的塵土跺下去，對他們作見證。」
verses.en: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when ye depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.

verses.zh: 門徒就出去傳道，叫人悔改，
verses.en: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.

verses.zh: 又趕出許多的鬼，用油抹了許多病人，治好他們。
verses.en: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.

verses.zh: 耶穌的名聲傳揚出來。希律王聽見了，就說：「施洗的約翰從死裏復活了，所以這些異能由他裏面發出來。」
verses.en: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.

verses.zh: 但別人說：「是以利亞。」又有人說：「是先知，[正]像先知中的一位。」
verses.en: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.

verses.zh: 希律聽見卻說：「是我所斬的約翰，他復活了。」
verses.en: But when Herod heard thereof, he said, It is John, whom I beheaded: he is risen from the dead.

verses.zh: 先是希律為他兄弟腓力的妻子希羅底的緣故，差人去拿住約翰，鎖在監裏，因為希律已經娶了那婦人。
verses.en: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias' sake, his brother Philip's wife: for he had married her.

verses.zh: 約翰曾對希律說：「你娶你兄弟的妻子是不合理的。」
verses.en: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy brother's wife.

verses.zh: 於是希羅底懷恨他，想要殺他，只是不能；
verses.en: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:

verses.zh: 因為希律知道約翰是義人，是聖人，所以敬畏他，保護他，聽他講論，就多照着行，並且樂意聽他。
verses.en: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.

verses.zh: 有一天，恰巧是希律的生日，希律擺設筵席，請了大臣和千夫長，並加利利作首領的。
verses.en: And when a convenient day was come, that Herod on his birthday made a supper to his lords, high captains, and chief estates of Galilee;

verses.zh: 希羅底的女兒進來跳舞，使希律和同席的人都歡喜。王就對女子說：「你隨意向我求甚麼，我必給你。」
verses.en: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever thou wilt, and I will give it thee.

verses.zh: 又對她起誓說：「隨你向我求甚麼，就是我國的一半，我也必給你。」
verses.en: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever thou shalt ask of me, I will give it thee, unto the half of my kingdom.

verses.zh: 她就出去對她母親說：「我可以求甚麼呢？」她母親說：「施洗約翰的頭。」
verses.en: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.

verses.zh: 她就急忙進去見王，求他說：「我願王立時把施洗約翰的頭放在盤子裏給我。」
verses.en: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that thou give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.

verses.zh: 王就甚憂愁；但因他所起的誓，又因同席的人，就不肯推辭，
verses.en: And the king was exceeding sorry; yet for his oath's sake, and for their sakes which sat with him, he would not reject her.

verses.zh: 隨即差一個護衛兵，吩咐拿約翰的頭來。護衛兵就去，在監裏斬了約翰，
verses.en: And immediately the king sent an executioner, and commanded his head to be brought: and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

verses.zh: 把頭放在盤子裏，拿來給女子，女子就給她母親。
verses.en: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.

verses.zh: 約翰的門徒聽見了，就來把他的屍首領去，葬在墳墓裏。
verses.en: And when his disciples heard of it, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.

verses.zh: 使徒聚集到耶穌那裏，將一切所做的事、所傳的道全告訴他。
verses.en: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Jesus, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.

verses.zh: 他就說：「你們來，同我暗暗地到曠野地方去歇一歇。」這是因為來往的人多，他們連吃飯也沒有工夫。
verses.en: And he said unto them, Come ye yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

verses.zh: 他們就坐船，暗暗地往曠野地方去。
verses.en: And they departed into a desert place by ship privately.

verses.zh: [眾人]看見他們去，有許多認識他們的，就從各城步行，一同跑到那裏，比他們先趕到了。
verses.en: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.

verses.zh: 耶穌出來，見有許多的人，就憐憫他們，因為他們如同羊沒有牧人一般，於是開口教訓他們許多道理。
verses.en: And Jesus, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.

verses.zh: 天已經晚了，門徒進前來，說：「這是野地，天已經晚了，
verses.en: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:

verses.zh: 請叫眾人散開，他們好往四面鄉村裏去，自己買甚麼吃。」
verses.en: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.

verses.zh: 耶穌回答說：「你們給他們吃吧。」門徒說：「我們可以去買二十兩銀子的餅給他們吃嗎？」
verses.en: He answered and said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they say unto him, Shall we go and buy two hundred pennyworth of bread, and give them to eat?

verses.zh: 耶穌說：「你們有多少餅，可以去看看。」他們知道了，就說：「五個餅，兩條魚。」
verses.en: He saith unto them, How many loaves have ye? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.

verses.zh: 耶穌吩咐他們，叫眾人一幫一幫地坐在青草地上。
verses.en: And he commanded them to make all sit down by companies upon the green grass.

verses.zh: 眾人就一排一排地坐下，有一百一排的，有五十一排的。
verses.en: And they sat down in ranks, by hundreds, and by fifties.

verses.zh: 耶穌拿着這五個餅，兩條魚，望着天祝福，擘開餅，遞給門徒，擺在眾人面前，也把那兩條魚分給眾人。
verses.en: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.

verses.zh: 他們都吃，並且吃飽了。
verses.en: And they did all eat, and were filled.

verses.zh: 門徒就把碎餅碎魚收拾起來，裝滿了十二個籃子。
verses.en: And they took up twelve baskets full of the fragments, and of the fishes.

verses.zh: 吃餅的男人共有五千。
verses.en: And they that did eat of the loaves were about five thousand men.

verses.zh: 耶穌隨即催門徒上船，先渡到那邊伯賽大去，等他叫眾人散開。
verses.en: And straightway he constrained his disciples to get into the ship, and to go to the other side before unto Bethsaida, while he sent away the people.

verses.zh: 他既辭別了他們，就往山上去禱告。
verses.en: And when he had sent them away, he departed into a mountain to pray.

verses.zh: 到了晚上，船在海中，耶穌獨自在岸上；
verses.en: And when even was come, the ship was in the midst of the sea, and he alone on the land.

verses.zh: 看見門徒因風不順，搖櫓甚苦。夜裏約有四更天，就在海面上走，往他們那裏去，意思要走過他們去。
verses.en: And he saw them toiling in rowing; for the wind was contrary unto them: and about the fourth watch of the night he cometh unto them, walking upon the sea, and would have passed by them.

verses.zh: 但門徒看見他在海面上走，以為是鬼怪，就喊叫起來；
verses.en: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:

verses.zh: 因為他們都看見了他，且甚驚慌。耶穌連忙對他們說：「你們放心！是我，不要怕！」
verses.en: For they all saw him, and were troubled. And immediately he talked with them, and saith unto them, Be of good cheer: it is I; be not afraid.

verses.zh: 於是到他們那裏，上了船，風就住了；他們心裏十分驚奇。
verses.en: And he went up unto them into the ship; and the wind ceased: and they were sore amazed in themselves beyond measure, and wondered.

verses.zh: 這是因為他們不明白那分餅的事，心裏還是愚頑。
verses.en: For they considered not the miracle of the loaves: for their heart was hardened.

verses.zh: 既渡過去，來到革尼撒勒地方，就靠了岸，
verses.en: And when they had passed over, they came into the land of Gennesaret, and drew to the shore.

verses.zh: 一下船，眾人認得是耶穌，
verses.en: And when they were come out of the ship, straightway they knew him,

verses.zh: 就跑遍那一帶地方，聽見他在何處，便將有病的人用褥子抬到那裏。
verses.en: And ran through that whole region round about, and began to carry about in beds those that were sick, where they heard he was.

verses.zh: 凡耶穌所到的地方，或村中，或城裏，或鄉間，他們都將病人放在街市上，求耶穌只容他們摸他的衣裳繸子；凡摸着的人就都好了。
verses.en: And whithersoever he entered, into villages, or cities, or country, they laid the sick in the streets, and besought him that they might touch if it were but the border of his garment: and as many as touched him were made whole.

verses.zh: 有法利賽人和幾個文士從耶路撒冷來，到耶穌那裏聚集。
verses.en: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.

verses.zh: 他們曾看見他的門徒中有人用俗手，就是沒有洗的手，吃飯。（
verses.en: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.

verses.zh: 原來法利賽人和猶太人都拘守古人的遺傳，若不仔細洗手就不吃飯；
verses.en: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.

verses.zh: 從市上來，若不洗浴也不吃飯；還有好些別的規矩，他們歷代拘守，就是洗杯、罐、銅器[等物]。）
verses.en: And when they come from the market, except they wash, they eat not. And many other things there be, which they have received to hold, as the washing of cups, and pots, brasen vessels, and of tables.

verses.zh: 法利賽人和文士問他說：「你的門徒為甚麼不照古人的遺傳，用俗手吃飯呢？」
verses.en: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not thy disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?

verses.zh: 耶穌說：「以賽亞指着你們假冒為善之人所說的預言是不錯的。如經上說： 這百姓用嘴唇尊敬我， 心卻遠離我。
verses.en: He answered and said unto them, Well hath Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

verses.zh: 他們將人的吩咐當作道理教導人， 所以拜我也是枉然。
verses.en: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.

verses.zh: 你們是離棄上帝的誡命，拘守人的遺傳」；
verses.en: For laying aside the commandment of God, ye hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things ye do.

verses.zh: 又說：「你們誠然是廢棄上帝的誡命，要守自己的遺傳。
verses.en: And he said unto them, Full well ye reject the commandment of God, that ye may keep your own tradition.

verses.zh: 摩西說：『當孝敬父母』；又說：『咒罵父母的，必治死他。』
verses.en: For Moses said, Honour thy father and thy mother; and, Whoso curseth father or mother, let him die the death:

verses.zh: 你們倒說：『人若對父母說：我所當奉給你的，已經作了各耳板』（各耳板就是供獻的意思），
verses.en: But ye say, If a man shall say to his father or mother, It is Corban, that is to say, a gift, by whatsoever thou mightest be profited by me; he shall be free.

verses.zh: 以後你們就不容他再奉養父母。
verses.en: And ye suffer him no more to do ought for his father or his mother;

verses.zh: 這就是你們承接遺傳，廢了上帝的道。你們還做許多這樣的事。」
verses.en: Making the word of God of none effect through your tradition, which ye have delivered: and many such like things do ye.

verses.zh: 耶穌又叫眾人來，對他們說：「你們都要聽我的話，也要明白。
verses.en: And when he had called all the people unto him, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:

verses.zh: 從外面進去的不能污穢人，惟有從裏面出來的乃能污穢人。」
verses.en: There is nothing from without a man, that entering into him can defile him: but the things which come out of him, those are they that defile the man.
If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.

verses.zh: 耶穌離開眾人，進了屋子，門徒就問他這比喻的意思。
verses.en: And when he was entered into the house from the people, his disciples asked him concerning the parable.

verses.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「你們也是這樣不明白嗎？豈不曉得凡從外面進入的，不能污穢人，
verses.en: And he saith unto them, Are ye so without understanding also? Do ye not perceive, that whatsoever thing from without entereth into the man, it cannot defile him;

verses.zh: 因為不是入他的心，乃是入他的肚腹，又落到茅廁裏（ [這是說]，各樣的食物都是潔淨的）」；
verses.en: Because it entereth not into his heart, but into the belly, and goeth out into the draught, purging all meats?

verses.zh: 又說：「從人裏面出來的，那才能污穢人；
verses.en: And he said, That which cometh out of the man, that defileth the man.

verses.zh: 因為從裏面，就是從人心裏，發出惡念、苟合、
verses.en: For from within, out of the heart of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, fornications, murders,

verses.zh: 偷盜、凶殺、姦淫、貪婪、邪惡、詭詐、淫蕩、嫉妒、謗讟、驕傲、狂妄。
verses.en: Thefts, covetousness, wickedness, deceit, lasciviousness, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, foolishness:

verses.zh: 這一切的惡都是從裏面出來，且能污穢人。」
verses.en: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.

verses.zh: 耶穌從那裏起身，往泰爾、西頓的境內去，進了一家，不願意人知道，卻隱藏不住。
verses.en: And from thence he arose, and went into the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and entered into an house, and would have no man know it: but he could not be hid.

verses.zh: 當下，有一個婦人，她的小女兒被污鬼附着，聽見耶穌的事，就來俯伏在他腳前。
verses.en: For a certain woman, whose young daughter had an unclean spirit, heard of him, and came and fell at his feet:

verses.zh: 這婦人是希臘人，屬敘利腓尼基族。她求耶穌趕出那鬼離開她的女兒。
verses.en: The woman was a Greek, a Syrophenician by nation; and she besought him that he would cast forth the devil out of her daughter.

verses.zh: 耶穌對她說：「讓兒女們先吃飽，不好拿兒女的餅丟給狗吃。」
verses.en: But Jesus said unto her, Let the children first be filled: for it is not meet to take the children's bread, and to cast it unto the dogs.

verses.zh: 婦人回答說：「主啊，不錯；但是狗在桌子底下也吃孩子們的碎渣兒。」
verses.en: And she answered and said unto him, Yes, Lord: yet the dogs under the table eat of the children's crumbs.

verses.zh: 耶穌對她說：「因這句話，你回去吧；鬼已經離開你的女兒了。」
verses.en: And he said unto her, For this saying go thy way; the devil is gone out of thy daughter.

verses.zh: 她就回家去，見小孩子躺在床上，鬼已經出去了。
verses.en: And when she was come to her house, she found the devil gone out, and her daughter laid upon the bed.

verses.zh: 耶穌又離了泰爾的境界，經過西頓，就從低加坡里境內來到加利利 海。
verses.en: And again, departing from the coasts of Tyre and Sidon, he came unto the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the coasts of Decapolis.

verses.zh: 有人帶着一個耳聾舌結的人來見耶穌，求他按手在他身上。
verses.en: And they bring unto him one that was deaf, and had an impediment in his speech; and they beseech him to put his hand upon him.

verses.zh: 耶穌領他離開眾人，到一邊去，就用指頭探他的耳朵，吐唾沫抹他的舌頭，
verses.en: And he took him aside from the multitude, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spit, and touched his tongue;

verses.zh: 望天歎息，對他說：「以法大！」就是說：「開了吧！」
verses.en: And looking up to heaven, he sighed, and saith unto him, Ephphatha, that is, Be opened.

verses.zh: 他的耳朵就開了，舌結也解了，說話也清楚了。
verses.en: And straightway his ears were opened, and the string of his tongue was loosed, and he spake plain.

verses.zh: 耶穌囑咐他們不要告訴人；但他越發囑咐，他們越發傳揚開了。
verses.en: And he charged them that they should tell no man: but the more he charged them, so much the more a great deal they published it;

verses.zh: 眾人分外希奇，說：「他所做的事都好，他連聾子也叫他們聽見，啞巴也叫他們說話。」
verses.en: And were beyond measure astonished, saying, He hath done all things well: he maketh both the deaf to hear, and the dumb to speak.

verses.zh: 那時，又有許多人聚集，並沒有甚麼吃的。耶穌叫門徒來，說：
verses.en: In those days the multitude being very great, and having nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples unto him, and saith unto them,

verses.zh: 「我憐憫這眾人；因為他們同我在這裏已經三天，也沒有吃的了。
verses.en: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have now been with me three days, and have nothing to eat:

verses.zh: 我若打發他們餓着回家，就必在路上困乏，因為其中有從遠處來的。」
verses.en: And if I send them away fasting to their own houses, they will faint by the way: for divers of them came from far.

verses.zh: 門徒回答說：「在這野地，從哪裏能得餅，叫這些人吃飽呢？」
verses.en: And his disciples answered him, From whence can a man satisfy these men with bread here in the wilderness?

verses.zh: 耶穌問他們說：「你們有多少餅？」他們說：「七個。」
verses.en: And he asked them, How many loaves have ye? And they said, Seven.

verses.zh: 他吩咐眾人坐在地上，就拿着這七個餅祝謝了，擘開，遞給門徒，叫他們擺開，門徒就擺在眾人面前。
verses.en: And he commanded the people to sit down on the ground: and he took the seven loaves, and gave thanks, and brake, and gave to his disciples to set before them; and they did set them before the people.

verses.zh: 又有幾條小魚；耶穌祝了福，就吩咐也擺在眾人面前。
verses.en: And they had a few small fishes: and he blessed, and commanded to set them also before them.

verses.zh: 眾人都吃，並且吃飽了，收拾剩下的零碎，有七筐子。
verses.en: So they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets.

verses.zh: 人數約有四千。耶穌打發他們走了，
verses.en: And they that had eaten were about four thousand: and he sent them away.

verses.zh: 隨即同門徒上船，來到大瑪努他境內。
verses.en: And straightway he entered into a ship with his disciples, and came into the parts of Dalmanutha.

verses.zh: 法利賽人出來盤問耶穌，求他從天上顯個神蹟給他們看，想要試探他。
verses.en: And the Pharisees came forth, and began to question with him, seeking of him a sign from heaven, tempting him.

verses.zh: 耶穌心裏深深地歎息，說：「這世代為甚麼求神蹟呢？我實在告訴你們，沒有神蹟給這世代看。」
verses.en: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.

verses.zh: 他就離開他們，又上[船]往海那邊去了。
verses.en: And he left them, and entering into the ship again departed to the other side.

verses.zh: 門徒忘了帶餅；在船上除了一個餅，沒有別的食物。
verses.en: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.

verses.zh: 耶穌囑咐他們說：「你們要謹慎，防備法利賽人的酵和希律的酵。」
verses.en: And he charged them, saying, Take heed, beware of the leaven of the Pharisees, and of the leaven of Herod.

verses.zh: 他們彼此議論說：「[這是因為]我們沒有餅吧。」
verses.en: And they reasoned among themselves, saying, It is because we have no bread.

verses.zh: 耶穌看出來，就說：「你們為甚麼因為沒有餅就議論呢？你們還不省悟，還不明白嗎？你們的心還是愚頑嗎？
verses.en: And when Jesus knew it, he saith unto them, Why reason ye, because ye have no bread? perceive ye not yet, neither understand? have ye your heart yet hardened?

verses.zh: 你們有眼睛，看不見嗎？有耳朵，聽不見嗎？也不記得嗎？
verses.en: Having eyes, see ye not? and having ears, hear ye not? and do ye not remember?

verses.zh: 我擘開那五個餅分給五千人，你們收拾的零碎裝滿了多少籃子呢？」他們說：「十二個。」
verses.en: When I brake the five loaves among five thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? They say unto him, Twelve.

verses.zh: 「[又擘開]那七個餅分給四千人，你們收拾的零碎裝滿了多少筐子呢？」他們說：「七個。」
verses.en: And when the seven among four thousand, how many baskets full of fragments took ye up? And they said, Seven.

verses.zh: 耶穌說：「你們還是不明白嗎？」
verses.en: And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?

verses.zh: 他們來到伯賽大，有人帶一個瞎子來，求耶穌摸他。
verses.en: And he cometh to Bethsaida; and they bring a blind man unto him, and besought him to touch him.

verses.zh: 耶穌拉着瞎子的手，領他到村外，就吐唾沫在他眼睛上，按手在他身上，問他說：「你看見甚麼了？」
verses.en: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.

verses.zh: 他就抬頭一看，說：「我看見人了；他們好像樹木，並且行走。」
verses.en: And he looked up, and said, I see men as trees, walking.

verses.zh: 隨後又按手在他眼睛上，他定睛一看，就復了原，樣樣都看得清楚了。
verses.en: After that he put his hands again upon his eyes, and made him look up: and he was restored, and saw every man clearly.

verses.zh: 耶穌打發他回家，說：「連這村子你也不要進去。」
verses.en: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town.

verses.zh: 耶穌和門徒出去，往凱撒利亞‧腓立比村莊去；在路上問門徒說：「人說我是誰？」
verses.en: And Jesus went out, and his disciples, into the towns of Caesarea Philippi: and by the way he asked his disciples, saying unto them, Whom do men say that I am?

verses.zh: 他們說：「[有人說]是施洗的約翰；有人說是以利亞；又有人說是先知裏的一位。」
verses.en: And they answered, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others, One of the prophets.

verses.zh: 又問他們說：「你們說我是誰？」彼得回答說：「你是基督。」
verses.en: And he saith unto them, But whom say ye that I am? And Peter answereth and saith unto him, Thou art the Christ.

verses.zh: 耶穌就禁戒他們，不要告訴人。
verses.en: And he charged them that they should tell no man of him.

verses.zh: 從此，他教訓他們說：「人子必須受許多的苦，被長老、祭司長，和文士棄絕，並且被殺，過三天復活。」
verses.en: And he began to teach them, that the Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders, and of the chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

verses.zh: 耶穌明明地說這話，彼得就拉着他，勸他。
verses.en: And he spake that saying openly. And Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.

verses.zh: 耶穌轉過來，看着門徒，就責備彼得說：「撒但，退我後邊去吧！因為你不體貼上帝的意思，只體貼人的意思。」
verses.en: But when he had turned about and looked on his disciples, he rebuked Peter, saying, Get thee behind me, Satan: for thou savourest not the things that be of God, but the things that be of men.

verses.zh: 於是叫眾人和門徒來，對他們說：「若有人要跟從我，就當捨己，背起他的十字架來跟從我。
verses.en: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

verses.zh: 因為，凡要救自己生命的，必喪掉生命；凡為我和福音喪掉生命的，必救了生命。
verses.en: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it; but whosoever shall lose his life for my sake and the gospel's, the same shall save it.

verses.zh: 人就是賺得全世界，賠上自己的生命，有甚麼益處呢？
verses.en: For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?

verses.zh: 人還能拿甚麼換生命呢？
verses.en: Or what shall a man give in exchange for his soul?

verses.zh: 凡在這淫亂罪惡的世代，把我和我的道當作可恥的，人子在他父的榮耀裏，同聖天使降臨的時候，也要把那人當作可恥的。」
verses.en: Whosoever therefore shall be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation; of him also shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he cometh in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.

verses.zh: 耶穌又對他們說：「我實在告訴你們，站在這裏的，有人在沒嘗死味以前，必要看見上帝的國大有能力臨到。」
verses.en: And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That there be some of them that stand here, which shall not taste of death, till they have seen the kingdom of God come with power.

verses.zh: 過了六天，耶穌帶着彼得、雅各、約翰暗暗地上了高山，就在他們面前變了形像，
verses.en: And after six days Jesus taketh with him Peter, and James, and John, and leadeth them up into an high mountain apart by themselves: and he was transfigured before them.

verses.zh: 衣服放光，極其潔白，地上漂布的，沒有一個能漂得那樣白。
verses.en: And his raiment became shining, exceeding white as snow; so as no fuller on earth can white them.

verses.zh: [忽然]，有以利亞同摩西向他們顯現，並且和耶穌說話。
verses.en: And there appeared unto them Elias with Moses: and they were talking with Jesus.

verses.zh: 彼得對耶穌說：「拉比，我們在這裏真好！可以搭三座棚，一座為你，一座為摩西，一座為以利亞。」
verses.en: And Peter answered and said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

verses.zh: 彼得不知道說甚麼才好，因為他們甚是懼怕。
verses.en: For he wist not what to say; for they were sore afraid.

verses.zh: 有一朵雲彩來遮蓋他們；也有聲音從雲彩裏出來，說：「這是我的愛子，你們要聽他。」
verses.en: And there was a cloud that overshadowed them: and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.

verses.zh: 門徒忽然周圍一看，不再見一人，只見耶穌同他們在那裏。
verses.en: And suddenly, when they had looked round about, they saw no man any more, save Jesus only with themselves.

verses.zh: 下山的時候，耶穌囑咐他們說：「人子還沒有從死裏復活，你們不要將所看見的告訴人。」
verses.en: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.

verses.zh: 門徒將這話存記在心，彼此議論「從死裏復活」是甚麼意思。
verses.en: And they kept that saying with themselves, questioning one with another what the rising from the dead should mean.

verses.zh: 他們就問耶穌說：「文士為甚麼說以利亞必須先來？」
verses.en: And they asked him, saying, Why say the scribes that Elias must first come?

verses.zh: 耶穌說：「以利亞固然先來復興萬事；[經上]不是指着人子說，他要受許多的苦被人輕慢呢？
verses.en: And he answered and told them, Elias verily cometh first, and restoreth all things; and how it is written of the Son of man, that he must suffer many things, and be set at nought.

verses.zh: 我告訴你們，以利亞已經來了，他們也任意待他，正如[經上]所指着他的話。」
verses.en: But I say unto you, That Elias is indeed come, and they have done unto him whatsoever they listed, as it is written of him.

verses.zh: 耶穌到了門徒那裏，看見有許多人圍着他們，又有文士和他們辯論。
verses.en: And when he came to his disciples, he saw a great multitude about them, and the scribes questioning with them.

verses.zh: 眾人一見耶穌，都甚希奇，就跑上去問他的安。
verses.en: And straightway all the people, when they beheld him, were greatly amazed, and running to him saluted him.

verses.zh: 耶穌問他們說：「你們和他們辯論的是甚麼？」
verses.en: And he asked the scribes, What question ye with them?

verses.zh: 眾人中間有一個人回答說：「夫子，我帶了我的兒子到你這裏來，他被啞巴鬼附着。
verses.en: And one of the multitude answered and said, Master, I have brought unto thee my son, which hath a dumb spirit;

verses.zh: 無論在哪裏，鬼捉弄他，把他摔倒，他就口中流沫，咬牙切齒，身體枯乾。我請過你的門徒把鬼趕出去，他們卻是不能。」
verses.en: And wheresoever he taketh him, he teareth him: and he foameth, and gnasheth with his teeth, and pineth away: and I spake to thy disciples that they should cast him out; and they could not.

verses.zh: 耶穌說：「噯！不信的世代啊，我在你們這裏要到幾時呢？我忍耐你們要到幾時呢？把他帶到我這裏來吧。」
verses.en: He answereth him, and saith, O faithless generation, how long shall I be with you? how long shall I suffer you? bring him unto me.

verses.zh: 他們就帶了他來。他一見耶穌，鬼便叫他重重地抽瘋，倒在地上，翻來覆去，口中流沫。
verses.en: And they brought him unto him: and when he saw him, straightway the spirit tare him; and he fell on the ground, and wallowed foaming.

verses.zh: 耶穌問他父親說：「他得這病有多少日子呢？」回答說：「從小的時候。
verses.en: And he asked his father, How long is it ago since this came unto him? And he said, Of a child.

verses.zh: 鬼屢次把他扔在火裏、水裏，要滅他。你若能做甚麼，求你憐憫我們，幫助我們。」
verses.en: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.

verses.zh: 耶穌對他說：「你若能[信]，在信的人，凡事都能。」
verses.en: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.

verses.zh: 孩子的父親立時喊着說：「我信！但我信不足，求主幫助。」
verses.en: And straightway the father of the child cried out, and said with tears, Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.

verses.zh: 耶穌看見眾人都跑上來， 就斥責那污鬼，說：「你這聾啞的鬼，我吩咐你從他裏頭出來，再不要進去！」
verses.en: When Jesus saw that the people came running together, he rebuked the foul spirit, saying unto him, Thou dumb and deaf spirit, I charge thee, come out of him, and enter no more into him.

verses.zh: 那鬼喊叫，使孩子大大地抽了一陣瘋，就出來了。[孩子]好像死了一般，以致眾人多半說：「他是死了。」
verses.en: And the spirit cried, and rent him sore, and came out of him: and he was as one dead; insomuch that many said, He is dead.

verses.zh: 但耶穌拉着他的手，扶他起來，他就站起來了。
verses.en: But Jesus took him by the hand, and lifted him up; and he arose.

verses.zh: 耶穌進了屋子，門徒就暗暗地問他說：「我們為甚麼不能趕出他去呢？」
verses.en: And when he was come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why could not we cast him out?

verses.zh: 耶穌說：「非用禱告，這一類的[鬼]總不能出來。」
verses.en: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.

verses.zh: 他們離開那地方，經過加利利；耶穌不願意人知道。
verses.en: And they departed thence, and passed through Galilee; and he would not that any man should know it.

verses.zh: 於是教訓門徒，說：「人子將要被交在人手裏，他們要殺害他；被殺以後，過三天他要復活。」
verses.en: For he taught his disciples, and said unto them, The Son of man is delivered into the hands of men, and they shall kill him; and after that he is killed, he shall rise the third day.

verses.zh: 門徒卻不明白這話，又不敢問他。
verses.en: But they understood not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.

verses.zh: 他們來到迦百農。耶穌在屋裏問門徒說：「你們在路上議論的是甚麼？」
verses.en: And he came to Capernaum: and being in the house he asked them, What was it that ye disputed among yourselves by the way?

verses.zh: 門徒不作聲，因為他們在路上彼此爭論誰為大。
verses.en: But they held their peace: for by the way they had disputed among themselves, who should be the greatest.

verses.zh: 耶穌坐下，叫十二個門徒來，說：「若有人願意作首先的，他必作眾人末後的，作眾人的用人。」
verses.en: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.

verses.zh: 於是領過一個小孩子來，叫他站在門徒中間，又抱起他來，對他們說：
verses.en: And he took a child, and set him in the midst of them: and when he had taken him in his arms, he said unto them,

verses.zh: 「凡為我名接待一個像這小孩子的，就是接待我；凡接待我的，不是接待我，乃是接待那差我來的。」
verses.en: Whosoever shall receive one of such children in my name, receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me, receiveth not me, but him that sent me.

verses.zh: 約翰對耶穌說：「夫子，我們看見一個人奉你的名趕鬼，我們就禁止他，因為他不跟從我們。」
verses.en: And John answered him, saying, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name, and he followeth not us: and we forbad him, because he followeth not us.

verses.zh: 耶穌說：「不要禁止他；因為沒有人奉我名行異能，反倒輕易毀謗我。
verses.en: But Jesus said, Forbid him not: for there is no man which shall do a miracle in my name, that can lightly speak evil of me.

verses.zh: 不敵擋我們的，就是幫助我們的。
verses.en: For he that is not against us is on our part.

verses.zh: 凡因你們是屬基督，給你們一杯水喝的，我實在告訴你們，他不能不得賞賜。」
verses.en: For whosoever shall give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because ye belong to Christ, verily I say unto you, he shall not lose his reward.

verses.zh: 「凡使這信我的一個小子跌倒的，倒不如把大磨石拴在這人的頸項上，扔在海裏。
verses.en: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.

verses.zh: 倘若你一隻手叫你跌倒，就把它砍下來；
verses.en: And if thy hand offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter into life maimed, than having two hands to go into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

verses.zh: 你缺了肢體進入[永]生，強如有兩[隻]手落到地獄，入那不滅的火裏去。
verses.en: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

verses.zh: 倘若你一隻腳叫你跌倒，就把它 砍下來；
verses.en: And if thy foot offend thee, cut it off: it is better for thee to enter halt into life, than having two feet to be cast into hell, into the fire that never shall be quenched:

verses.zh: 你瘸腿進入[永]生，強如有兩隻腳被丟在地獄裏。
verses.en: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

verses.zh: 倘若你一隻眼叫你跌倒，就去掉它；你只有一隻眼進入上帝的國，強如有兩隻眼被丟在地獄裏。
verses.en: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out: it is better for thee to enter into the kingdom of God with one eye, than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire:

verses.zh: 在那裏，蟲是不死的，火是不滅的。
verses.en: Where their worm dieth not, and the fire is not quenched.

verses.zh: 因為必用火當鹽醃各人。
verses.en: For every one shall be salted with fire, and every sacrifice shall be salted with salt.

verses.zh: 鹽本是好的，若失了味，可用甚麼叫它再鹹呢？你們裏頭應當有鹽，彼此和睦。」
verses.en: Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his saltness, wherewith will ye season it? Have salt in yourselves, and have peace one with another.

verses.zh: 耶穌從那裏起身，來到猶太的境界並約旦河外。眾人又聚集到他那裏，他又照常教訓他們。
verses.en: And he arose from thence, and cometh into the coasts of Judaea by the farther side of Jordan: and the people resort unto him again; and, as he was wont, he taught them again.

verses.zh: 有法利賽人來問他說：「人休妻可以不可以？」意思要試探他。
verses.en: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.

verses.zh: 耶穌回答說：「摩西吩咐你們的是甚麼？」
verses.en: And he answered and said unto them, What did Moses command you?

verses.zh: 他們說：「摩西許人寫了休書便可以休妻。」
verses.en: And they said, Moses suffered to write a bill of divorcement, and to put her away.

verses.zh: 耶穌說：「摩西因為你們的心硬，所以寫這條例給你們；
verses.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, For the hardness of your heart he wrote you this precept.

verses.zh: 但從起初創造的時候，上帝造人是造男造女。
verses.en: But from the beginning of the creation God made them male and female.

verses.zh: 因此，人要離開父母，與妻子連合，二人成為一體。
verses.en: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife;

verses.zh: 既然如此，夫妻不再是兩個人，乃是一體的了。
verses.en: And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh.

verses.zh: 所以，上帝配合的，人不可分開。」
verses.en: What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.

verses.zh: 到了屋裏，門徒就問他這事。
verses.en: And in the house his disciples asked him again of the same matter.

verses.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「凡休妻另娶的，就是犯姦淫，辜負他的妻子；
verses.en: And he saith unto them, Whosoever shall put away his wife, and marry another, committeth adultery against her.

verses.zh: 妻子若離棄丈夫另嫁，也是犯姦淫了。」
verses.en: And if a woman shall put away her husband, and be married to another, she committeth adultery.

verses.zh: 有人帶着小孩子來見耶穌，要耶穌摸他們，門徒便責備那些人。
verses.en: And they brought young children to him, that he should touch them: and his disciples rebuked those that brought them.

verses.zh: 耶穌看見就惱怒，對門徒說：「讓小孩子到我這裏來，不要禁止他們；因為在上帝國的，正是這樣的人。
verses.en: But when Jesus saw it, he was much displeased, and said unto them, Suffer the little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God.

verses.zh: 我實在告訴你們，凡要承受上帝國的，若不像小孩子，斷不能進去。」
verses.en: Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child, he shall not enter therein.

verses.zh: 於是抱着小孩子，給他們按手，為他們祝福。
verses.en: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.

verses.zh: 耶穌出來行路的時候，有一個人跑來，跪在他面前，問他說：「良善的夫子，我當做甚麼事才可以承受永生？」
verses.en: And when he was gone forth into the way, there came one running, and kneeled to him, and asked him, Good Master, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?

verses.zh: 耶穌對他說：「你為甚麼稱我是良善的？除了上帝一位之外，再沒有良善的。
verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.

verses.zh: 誡命你是曉得的：不可殺人；不可姦淫；不可偷盜；不可作假見證；不可虧負人；當孝敬父母。」
verses.en: Thou knowest the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Defraud not, Honour thy father and mother.

verses.zh: 他對耶穌說：「夫子，這一切我從小都遵守了。」
verses.en: And he answered and said unto him, Master, all these have I observed from my youth.

verses.zh: 耶穌看着他，就愛他，對他說：「你還缺少一件：去變賣你所有的，分給窮人，就必有財寶在天上；你還要來跟從我。」
verses.en: Then Jesus beholding him loved him, and said unto him, One thing thou lackest: go thy way, sell whatsoever thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, take up the cross, and follow me.

verses.zh: 他聽見這話，臉上就變了色，憂憂愁愁地走了，因為他的產業很多。
verses.en: And he was sad at that saying, and went away grieved: for he had great possessions.

verses.zh: 耶穌周圍一看，對門徒說：「有錢財的人進上帝的國是何等地難哪！」
verses.en: And Jesus looked round about, and saith unto his disciples, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!

verses.zh: 門徒希奇他的話。耶穌又對他們說：「小子，倚靠錢財的人進上帝的國是何等地難哪！
verses.en: And the disciples were astonished at his words. But Jesus answereth again, and saith unto them, Children, how hard is it for them that trust in riches to enter into the kingdom of God!

verses.zh: 駱駝穿過針的眼，比財主進上帝的國還容易呢。」
verses.en: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.

verses.zh: 門徒就分外希奇，對他說：「這樣誰能得救呢？」
verses.en: And they were astonished out of measure, saying among themselves, Who then can be saved?

verses.zh: 耶穌看着他們，說：「在人是不能，在上帝卻不然，因為上帝凡事都能。」
verses.en: And Jesus looking upon them saith, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for with God all things are possible.

verses.zh: 彼得就對他說：「看哪，我們已經撇下所有的跟從你了。」
verses.en: Then Peter began to say unto him, Lo, we have left all, and have followed thee.

verses.zh: 耶穌說：「我實在告訴你們，人為我和福音撇下房屋，或是弟兄、姊妹、父母、兒女、田地，
verses.en: And Jesus answered and said, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that hath left house, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my sake, and the gospel's,

verses.zh: 沒有不在今世得百倍的，就是房屋、弟兄、姊妹、母親、兒女、田地，並且要受逼迫，在來世必得永生。
verses.en: But he shall receive an hundredfold now in this time, houses, and brethren, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and lands, with persecutions; and in the world to come eternal life.

verses.zh: 然而，有許多在前的，將要在後，在後的，將要在前。」
verses.en: But many that are first shall be last; and the last first.

verses.zh: 他們行路上耶路撒冷去。耶穌在前頭走，門徒就希奇，跟從的人也害怕。耶穌又叫過十二個門徒來，把自己將要遭遇的事告訴他們說：
verses.en: And they were in the way going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus went before them: and they were amazed; and as they followed, they were afraid. And he took again the twelve, and began to tell them what things should happen unto him,

verses.zh: 「看哪，我們上耶路撒冷去，人子將要被交給祭司長和文士，他們要定他死罪，交給外邦人。
verses.en: Saying, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man shall be delivered unto the chief priests, and unto the scribes; and they shall condemn him to death, and shall deliver him to the Gentiles:

verses.zh: 他們要戲弄他，吐唾沫在他臉上，鞭打他，殺害他。過了三天，他要復活。」
verses.en: And they shall mock him, and shall scourge him, and shall spit upon him, and shall kill him: and the third day he shall rise again.

verses.zh: 西庇太的兒子雅各、約翰進前來，對耶穌說：「夫子，我們無論求你甚麼，願你給我們做。」
verses.en: And James and John, the sons of Zebedee, come unto him, saying, Master, we would that thou shouldest do for us whatsoever we shall desire.

verses.zh: 耶穌說：「要我給你們做甚麼？」
verses.en: And he said unto them, What would ye that I should do for you?

verses.zh: 他們說：「賜我們在你的榮耀裏，一個坐在你右邊，一個坐在你左邊。」
verses.en: They said unto him, Grant unto us that we may sit, one on thy right hand, and the other on thy left hand, in thy glory.

verses.zh: 耶穌說：「你們不知道所求的是甚麼。我所喝的杯，你們能喝嗎？我所受的洗，你們能受嗎？」
verses.en: But Jesus said unto them, Ye know not what ye ask: can ye drink of the cup that I drink of? and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?

verses.zh: 他們說：「我們能。」耶穌說：「我所喝的杯，你們也要喝；我所受的洗，你們也要受；
verses.en: And they said unto him, We can. And Jesus said unto them, Ye shall indeed drink of the cup that I drink of; and with the baptism that I am baptized withal shall ye be baptized:

verses.zh: 只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以賜的，乃是為誰預備的，就賜給誰。」
verses.en: But to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it shall be given to them for whom it is prepared.

verses.zh: 那十個門徒聽見，就惱怒雅各、約翰。
verses.en: And when the ten heard it, they began to be much displeased with James and John.

verses.zh: 耶穌叫他們來，對他們說：「你們知道，外邦人有尊為君王的，治理他們，有大臣操權管束他們。
verses.en: But Jesus called them to him, and saith unto them, Ye know that they which are accounted to rule over the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and their great ones exercise authority upon them.

verses.zh: 只是在你們中間，不是這樣。你們中間，誰願為大，就必作你們的用人；
verses.en: But so shall it not be among you: but whosoever will be great among you, shall be your minister:

verses.zh: 在你們中間，誰願為首，就必作眾人的僕人。
verses.en: And whosoever of you will be the chiefest, shall be servant of all.

verses.zh: 因為人子來，並不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，並且要捨命作多人的贖價。」
verses.en: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister, and to give his life a ransom for many.

verses.zh: 到了耶利哥；耶穌同門徒並許多人出耶利哥的時候，有一個討飯的瞎子，是底買的兒子巴底買，坐在路旁。
verses.en: And they came to Jericho: and as he went out of Jericho with his disciples and a great number of people, blind Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sat by the highway side begging.

verses.zh: 他聽見是拿撒勒的耶穌，就喊着說：「大衛的子孫耶穌啊！可憐我吧！」
verses.en: And when he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me.

verses.zh: 有許多人責備他，不許他作聲。他卻越發大聲喊着說：「大衛的子孫哪，可憐我吧！」
verses.en: And many charged him that he should hold his peace: but he cried the more a great deal, Thou son of David, have mercy on me.

verses.zh: 耶穌就站住，說：「叫過他來。」他們就叫那瞎子，對他說：「放心，起來！他叫你啦。」
verses.en: And Jesus stood still, and commanded him to be called. And they call the blind man, saying unto him, Be of good comfort, rise; he calleth thee.

verses.zh: 瞎子就丟下衣服，跳起來，走到耶穌那裏。
verses.en: And he, casting away his garment, rose, and came to Jesus.

verses.zh: 耶穌說：「要我為你做甚麼？」瞎子說：「拉波尼，我要能看見。」
verses.en: And Jesus answered and said unto him, What wilt thou that I should do unto thee? The blind man said unto him, Lord, that I might receive my sight.

verses.zh: 耶穌說：「你去吧！你的信救了你了。」瞎子立刻看見了，就在路上跟隨耶穌。
verses.en: And Jesus said unto him, Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.

verses.zh: 耶穌和門徒將近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其和伯大尼，在橄欖山那裏；耶穌就打發兩個門徒，
verses.en: And when they came nigh to Jerusalem, unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount of Olives, he sendeth forth two of his disciples,

verses.zh: 對他們說：「你們往對面村子裏去，一進去的時候，必看見一匹驢駒拴在那裏，是從來沒有人騎過的，可以解開，牽來。
verses.en: And saith unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as ye be entered into it, ye shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him.

verses.zh: 若有人對你們說：『為甚麼做這事？』你們就說：『主要用牠。 』那人必立時讓你們牽來。」
verses.en: And if any man say unto you, Why do ye this? say ye that the Lord hath need of him; and straightway he will send him hither.

verses.zh: 他們去了，便看見一匹驢駒拴在門外街道上，就把牠解開。
verses.en: And they went their way, and found the colt tied by the door without in a place where two ways met; and they loose him.

verses.zh: 在那裏站着的人，有幾個說：「你們解驢駒做甚麼？」
verses.en: And certain of them that stood there said unto them, What do ye, loosing the colt?

verses.zh: 門徒照着耶穌所說的回答，那些人就任憑他們牽去了。
verses.en: And they said unto them even as Jesus had commanded: and they let them go.

verses.zh: 他們把驢駒牽到耶穌那裏，把自己的衣服搭在上面，耶穌就騎上。
verses.en: And they brought the colt to Jesus, and cast their garments on him; and he sat upon him.

verses.zh: 有許多人把衣服鋪在路上，也有人把田間的樹枝砍下來，鋪在路上。
verses.en: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.

verses.zh: 前行後隨的人都喊着說： 和散那 ！ 奉主名來的是應當稱頌的！
verses.en: And they that went before, and they that followed, cried, saying, Hosanna; Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord:

verses.zh: 那將要來的我祖大衛之國是應當稱頌的！ 高高在上和散那！
verses.en: Blessed be the kingdom of our father David, that cometh in the name of the Lord: Hosanna in the highest.

verses.zh: 耶穌進了耶路撒冷，入了[聖]殿，周圍看了各樣物件。天色已晚，就和十二個門徒出城，往伯大尼去了。
verses.en: And Jesus entered into Jerusalem, and into the temple: and when he had looked round about upon all things, and now the eventide was come, he went out unto Bethany with the twelve.

verses.zh: 第二天，他們從伯大尼出來，耶穌餓了。
verses.en: And on the morrow, when they were come from Bethany, he was hungry:

verses.zh: 遠遠地看見一棵無花果樹，樹上有葉子，就往那裏去，或者在樹上可以找着甚麼。到了樹下，竟找不着甚麼，不過有葉子，因為不是收無花果的時候。
verses.en: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.

verses.zh: 耶穌就對樹說：「從今以後，永沒有人吃你的果子。」他的門徒也聽見了。
verses.en: And Jesus answered and said unto it, No man eat fruit of thee hereafter for ever. And his disciples heard it.

verses.zh: 他們來到耶路撒冷。耶穌進入[聖]殿，趕出殿裏做買賣的人，推倒兌換銀錢之人的桌子和賣鴿子之人的凳子；
verses.en: And they come to Jerusalem: and Jesus went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the seats of them that sold doves;

verses.zh: 也不許人拿着器具從殿裏經過；
verses.en: And would not suffer that any man should carry any vessel through the temple.

verses.zh: 便教訓他們說：「[經上]不是記着說： 我的殿必稱為萬國禱告的殿嗎？ 你們倒使它 成為賊窩了。」
verses.en: And he taught, saying unto them, Is it not written, My house shall be called of all nations the house of prayer? but ye have made it a den of thieves.

verses.zh: 祭司長和文士聽見這話，就想法子要除滅耶穌，卻又怕他，因為眾人都希奇他的教訓。
verses.en: And the scribes and chief priests heard it, and sought how they might destroy him: for they feared him, because all the people was astonished at his doctrine.

verses.zh: 每天晚上，耶穌出城去。
verses.en: And when even was come, he went out of the city.

verses.zh: 早晨，他們從那裏經過，看見無花果樹連根都枯乾了。
verses.en: And in the morning, as they passed by, they saw the fig tree dried up from the roots.

verses.zh: 彼得想起耶穌的話來，就對他說：「拉比，請看！你所咒詛的無花果樹已經枯乾了。」
verses.en: And Peter calling to remembrance saith unto him, Master, behold, the fig tree which thou cursedst is withered away.

verses.zh: 耶穌回答說：「你們當信服上帝。
verses.en: And Jesus answering saith unto them, Have faith in God.

verses.zh: 我實在告訴你們，無論何人對這座山說：『你挪開此地，投在海裏！』他若心裏不疑惑，只信他所說的必成，就必給他成了。
verses.en: For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea; and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.

verses.zh: 所以我告訴你們，凡你們禱告祈求的，無論是甚麼，只要信是得着的，就必得着。
verses.en: Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.

verses.zh: 你們站着禱告的時候，若想起有人得罪你們，就當饒恕他，好叫你們在天上的父也饒恕你們的過犯。
verses.en: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.

verses.zh: 你們若不饒恕人，你們在天上的父也不饒恕你們的過犯。 」
verses.en: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.

verses.zh: 他們又來到耶路撒冷。耶穌在殿裏行走的時候，祭司長和文士並長老進前來，
verses.en: And they come again to Jerusalem: and as he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders,

verses.zh: 問他說：「你仗着甚麼權柄做這些事？給你這權柄的是誰呢？」
verses.en: And say unto him, By what authority doest thou these things? and who gave thee this authority to do these things?

verses.zh: 耶穌對他們說：「我要問你們一句話，你們回答我，我就告訴你們我仗着甚麼權柄做這些事。
verses.en: And Jesus answered and said unto them, I will also ask of you one question, and answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

verses.zh: 約翰的洗禮是從天上來的？是從人間來的呢？你們可以回答我。」
verses.en: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? answer me.

verses.zh: 他們彼此商議說：「我們若說『從天上來』，他必說：『這樣，你們為甚麼不信他呢？』
verses.en: And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did ye not believe him?

verses.zh: 若說『從人間來』，卻又怕百姓，因為眾人真以約翰為先知。」
verses.en: But if we shall say, Of men; they feared the people: for all men counted John, that he was a prophet indeed.

verses.zh: 於是回答耶穌說：「我們不知道。」耶穌說：「我也不告訴你們我仗着甚麼權柄做這些事。」
verses.en: And they answered and said unto Jesus, We cannot tell. And Jesus answering saith unto them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.

verses.zh: 耶穌就用比喻對他們說：「有人栽了一個葡萄園，周圍圈上籬笆，挖了一個壓酒池，蓋了一座樓，租給園戶，就往外國去了。
verses.en: And he began to speak unto them by parables. A certain man planted a vineyard, and set an hedge about it, and digged a place for the winefat, and built a tower, and let it out to husbandmen, and went into a far country.

verses.zh: 到了時候，打發一個僕人到園戶那裏，要從園戶收葡萄園的果子。
verses.en: And at the season he sent to the husbandmen a servant, that he might receive from the husbandmen of the fruit of the vineyard.

verses.zh: 園戶拿住他，打了他，叫他空手回去。
verses.en: And they caught him, and beat him, and sent him away empty.

verses.zh: 再打發一個僕人到他們那裏。他們打傷他的頭，並且凌辱他。
verses.en: And again he sent unto them another servant; and at him they cast stones, and wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully handled.

verses.zh: 又打發一個僕人去，他們就殺了他。後又打發好些僕人去，有被他們打的，有被他們殺的。
verses.en: And again he sent another; and him they killed, and many others; beating some, and killing some.

verses.zh: 園主還有一位是他的愛子，末後又打發他去，[意思]說：『他們必尊敬我的兒子。』
verses.en: Having yet therefore one son, his wellbeloved, he sent him also last unto them, saying, They will reverence my son.

verses.zh: 不料，那些園戶彼此說：『這是承受產業的。來吧，我們殺他，產業就歸我們了！』
verses.en: But those husbandmen said among themselves, This is the heir; come, let us kill him, and the inheritance shall be ours.'
